name: Aria Fortuna
original_name: アリア・フォルトゥナ
source:
Affiliation: Edingard.

A girl who was summoned from another world (modern Japan) to become the princess shrine maiden of Edingard. Aria's house runs a Catholic church, and her father is a priest. She has a gentle personality, she treats any person indiscriminately, but she is sometimes bothered by a natural de-focusing behavior which makes her sick. She follows Felix, who helps her out in this strange world.
